title: WTM Maces - Books to Maces
description: Ever hated that the maces in your inventory are just regular old books?
body:
# Description
This is a simple texture pack that changes all of the enchanted books from [way too many maces](https://modrinth.com/datapack/silvers_way-too-many-maces) in to a mace when in the creaative inventory.
